# Snapit

Snapit posts invoices to the accounting system automatically.
https://trysnapit.com

Invoices go to the accounting system automatically.

What Snapit reads: Supplier, Invoice number, Date, Line items, Tax, Total, Duplicate check.

After one WhatsApp message:
Send a photo or PDF on WhatsApp.
Snapit reads the supplier, invoice number, date, tax, and total.
The bill and the original document post.
The same chat replies with the total.

Branch staff get the total back and a duplicate warning.
Finance sees every branch, posted or flagged.

Live: Xero, QuickBooks, Zoho Books.
Coming soon: NetSuite, Odoo, ERPNext, SQL Account, Mekari Jurnal, Accurate.
The REST API pulls invoice data and documents.
Webhooks push each invoice when it is read.
The WhatsApp step stays the same.

Any business that receives invoices: design agency, dental clinic, construction firm, logistics firm, retail chain, law firm, factory, school, startup, restaurant.
Accounting firms use one number per client and review instead of retyping.
